description:
About Workato 

 Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com . 

 Why join us? 

 Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles . We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company.  

 But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.  

 If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you! 

 Also, feel free to check out why: 

 
 
 Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on” 



 
 Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world 



 
 Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America 



 
 Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers 



 
 Responsibilities 

 We are looking for an experienced Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Forward Deployed Engineering team.. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI agentic solutions that exhibit autonomous, proactive, and adaptive behaviors. This role requires a deep understanding of AI/ML technologies, integration, automation experience, and solution architecture, combined with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.

 
 
 Implement agent-based AI solutions using the Workato Agentic AI platform



 
 Implement intelligent, autonomous, and efficient agentic AI workflows that utilize multi-agent collaboration, orchestration, and the automation capabilities provided by the Workato platform



 
 Implement and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using Workato’s Agentic AI capabilities, leveraging its connectors, workflows, and recipes to enable context-aware, grounded, and real-time responses from large language models (LLMs)



 
 Develop advanced prompting, memory management, and behavior-planning techniques to enable LLMs and agents to reliably author and execute complex workflows



 
 Act as a technical solutions expert with strong aptitude for troubleshooting and analyzing AI-driven architectures, including scalable RAG pipelines and agent frameworks built using the Workato Agentic AI platform



 
 Develop and maintain robust, scalable, AI-powered IT workflows with agent-based decision-making, dynamic retrieval mechanisms, and seamless integration using the Workato Agentic AI platform



 
 Continuously monitor and improve AI system performance, ensuring efficiency and reliability



 
 Work closely with customers to understand use cases and deliver tailored, scalable agentic AI and RAG-based solutions using the Workato Agentic AI platform, while prioritizing exceptional customer service to ensure alignment with both technical and business needs, as well as satisfaction and successful implementation



 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI workflows into existing IT frameworks, ensuring smooth and seamless deployment



 
 Contribute to internal process improvements and promote knowledge sharing by adding to Workato’s knowledge base



 
 Play an instrumental role in all phases of product development, from ideation to implementation, contributing valuable insights and expertise



 
 Assist the product manager in creating technical and design specifications, ensuring alignment with product goals and user needs



 
 Leverage strong communication skills to effectively translate complex technical concepts into accessible insights for non-technical audiences



 
 Requirements 

 Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills 

 
 
 BTech/BE or higher technical education in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field



 
 A total of 4+ years of relevant experience in design, development, and implementation.



 
 1+ year of experience with Workato or similar workplace orchestration and integration platform, is a must



 
 Proven experience in AI engineering, with a focus on agent-based systems



 
 Demonstrated ability to design and implement scalable AI-driven workflows that enhance IT operations



 
 Knowledge of implementing integration projects is essential. Hands-on experience with automation technologies, middleware, integration architecture patterns, web services technologies, enterprise messaging patterns, APIs, SOA, ESB, BPM, SDKs, and databases



 
 Experience working with integration platforms such as Workato, TIBCO, Dell Boomi, MuleSoft, or other integration/automation tools is a plus. Experience with cloud technologies—iPaaS, SaaS applications, and cloud infrastructure—is also a plus



 
 Strong working knowledge of APIs—RESTful, SOAP/XML. Solid understanding of data structures—JSON. Sound knowledge of any RDBMS/NoSQL



 
 Hands-on experience with any of the following: Java, Python, or Ruby



 
 Technical background or a solid understanding of technology and industry trends, especially in the app integration space



 
 Experience working with cloud business apps like Workday, NetSuite, Salesforce and ServiceNow - Marketo is a plus



 
 Good knowledge of microservices or API-based integration architecture, event-driven architecture, and process automation via BPM or RPA is a plus



 
 Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics 

 
 
 Strong collaboration skills, ability to adapt to a dynamic start-up environment, with a passion for making an impact



 Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, with an entrepreneurial and proactive mindset

 
 Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time, even under high-pressure situations



 
 Strong written and oral communication skills in English, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts effectively to a non-technical audience



 
 Fast learner who can independently conduct extensive research, and synthesize ideas, information, and options quickly



 
 Proactive in solving problems and ready to take on additional initiatives and responsibilities as they emerge



 
  

 For candidates based in California, New York, and Colorado the expected salary range for this role is $70,000–$100,000 not including bonus. Actual compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and location. This role may also be eligible for equity and benefits.

  

 Job Req ID: 2615
